title: Three Sentences on the Books
subtitle: 污染治理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 污染治理（环境保护·污染与治理）
meta: 主题语境：污染治理（环境保护·污染与治理）　|　核心词汇：policy　|　正文 362 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 policy 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The river ran black for eleven days in 1998 and nobody in the town has forgotten the smell. What I remember better is the meeting afterwards, and the word that ended it. The factory's man said the ① policy of the company was to co-operate fully, and somebody at the back laughed, and the laugh was the beginning of everything that followed. He meant ② policy the way a firm means it: a rule written by somebody else, which nobody in the room had signed and nobody in the room could change.

My father was on the council then and had spent two years trying to get a ③ policy on discharges written into the minutes. He used to say that a ④ policy is the only thing that survives the person who wrote it, and that the river would outlive us all and needed something that would outlive us too. In the end he got three sentences and a ⑤ policy of insurance that nobody understood.

The ⑥ insurance policy turned out to be the whole story. It insured the factory against interruption, not the town against pollution, and it was the reason the gates stayed shut for eleven days: shutting them was cheaper under the policy than cleaning the water. My father read it twice and said nothing, which was not like him.

As a matter of ⑦ policy the council had settled quietly for years. It was ⑧ policy, my father told me afterwards, to do exactly that, and had been for as long as anybody could remember. What stopped it was my mother, who had been at the meeting and had heard the laugh. She said ⑨ honesty is the best policy, which my father said was a thing people say when they have nothing else, and she said yes, and that was the point.

In 2003 the council passed a policy three sentences long, and it is still on the books: a discharge must be reported within four hours. The ⑩ policy my mother lived by was never to sign anything she had not read twice; she read the minutes four times, and found the sentence with my father's name on it, which nobody else had noticed.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 保险单；保单（an insurance policy）
C. n. 明智之举；上策（the best policy）
D. n. （公司的）规章；规定；制度（company policy）
E. 固定搭配：a policy on sth. 关于……的政策
F. 固定搭配：it is policy to do sth. 按惯例／按规定做某事
G. 固定搭配：as a matter of policy 作为一项既定方针；按惯例
H. n. 原则；处世准则（the policy one lives by）

items.q: the policy of the company was to co-operate fully
He meant policy the way a firm means it
a policy on discharges written into the minutes
a policy is the only thing that survives
a policy of insurance that nobody understood
The insurance policy turned out to be the whole story
As a matter of policy the council had settled quietly
It was policy, my father told me afterwards, to do exactly that
The policy my mother lived by

answers.why: the policy of the company 意为“公司的规定、制度”，指那句“全面配合”。
policy 取“政策；方针”义，说他用的是企业意义上那种由别人写下的规则。
a policy on sth. 意为“关于某事的政策”，此处是有关排污的政策。
a policy 意为“一项政策”，父亲说政策是唯一能活得比制定者更久的东西。
a policy of insurance 意为“一份保险单”，最后他只争到三句话和这份没人看懂的保单。
the insurance policy 意为“那份保险单”，它才是整件事的关键。
as a matter of policy 意为“按既定方针、按惯例”，议会多年来一直是悄悄和解。
it is policy to do sth. 意为“按规定／按惯例就这么做”，父亲说一直都是这么办的。
the best policy 意为“上策、最明智的做法”，母亲说诚实是上策。
the policy one lives by 意为“为人处世的原则”，母亲的原则是不签没读过两遍的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 那家公司的规定是全面配合。（policy）
父亲花了两年时间想把一项排污政策写进会议记录。（a policy on）
那份保险单承保的是工厂的停工损失，而不是本镇的污染。（insurance policy）
按惯例，议会多年来都是悄悄和解的。（as a matter of policy）
母亲说，诚实是上策。（the best policy）
父亲说，按惯例就是这么办的。（it is policy to do）
answers: The policy of the company was to co-operate fully.
My father spent two years trying to get a policy on discharges written into the minutes.
The insurance policy covered the factory against interruption, not the town against pollution.
As a matter of policy, the council had settled quietly for years.
My mother said honesty is the best policy.
My father said it was policy to do exactly that.
